plugins.name: effort-picker
plugins.description: Picks the effort for each message you send and tells you when it changes and why.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: One line above the chat: how full the chat is and how much of your 5-hour and weekly limits you've used.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Sorts a long message into goal, facts and asks before it's sent.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Walks you through Claude's file changes one at a time, track-changes style.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a handoff note, saves it, and restarts the chat from it.
